name: aqmen
description: The Aqmen connector plus thin skills for Claude. The method lives on the Aqmen platform — any connected agent reads it with read_instructions; the skills add what only Claude does: the six jobs (market sizing, company analysis, competitive landscape, due diligence, proposal, refresh) chaining the seven practices (scope, research, model, challenge, conclude, deliver, close) stage by stage, parallel researchers and fresh-context critics. Everything is made in Aqmen. Each job is a project in the client's workspace, ending in findings approved claim by claim and a deck whose every figure is sourced.
